description: Minimal IPC surface exposed to the live website's login page for password-manager-style autofill (save_login/get_saved_password/list_saved_usernames/forget_login only). Deliberately separate from the main window's own local 'default' capability, which has no 'remote' field and stays local-only -- this is the one and only bridge from the remote website's JS into the launcher's process, so it must never widen beyond these four commands.
